description_en: Summarizes the actual benefits of automatic clustering for a project, including the number of benefited jobs, saved compute unit (CU) hours, and shuffle data volume. You can filter the results by schema and table
description_zh: 汇总项目的自动聚簇实际收益，包括受益作业数、节省的 CU 时和 Shuffle 数据量。可按 Schema 和表过滤
name: GetAutoClusterUtilityByProject

parameters.help_en: The scope of benefit statistics. A value of false retrieves the daily benefits from the latest batch of data. A value of true calculates the cumulative benefits after automatic clustering is applied. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 收益统计范围。false 表示取最新一批数据中的当日收益，true 表示累计统计聚簇应用后的收益。默认为 false
parameters.name: since_created

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project
parameters.name: project
